sampling: Reserve complete novel task/ancestor components BEFORE candidate capture or labels. Collect EVERY consecutive eligible public candidate from each approved session, including failed/aborted/no-fit/missing-input events; no selection by score, label, style, usefulness or error appearance. Missing slots remain accounting events, never fabricated candidates.

initial_collection_design.note: Collection objectives, NOT power guarantees or facts about currently available data. Actual class/phenomenon/length/human-language support must be reported; expand as a new preregistered cohort if insufficient, never select favorable rows.

lineage: Exclude ALL six known real task families and ALL18 standalone seed groups, including quarantined inputs and inactive seeds. Exact hashes are necessary but insufficient. Two isolated whole-task/ancestor reviews must certify new scenario identity against the bound exclusions. Unknown ancestors or related tasks are held together or quarantined, never declared fresh by a new filename.
intake_profile: suite.training_evaluation.screen verifies dedicated whole native JSON candidate slots, full task source, native integer-nanosecond event source, SHA bindings, pre-capture reservations, explicit reviewed ancestry, and all task/group/session/run/raw/input edges. Other source schemas require an explicit complete source adapter; no timestamp inference from mtime or filenames. Whole task text has its own exact-hash exclusion, independent of renamed task/group metadata, and reservations cannot replace the master exclusion baseline.
intake_limit: Screen success is ONLY custody/lineage intake eligibility, NOT source authenticity certification, label/privacy admission, fresh gold, representative coverage or permission for inference. Native source/producer/public-channel evidence must be independently checked. No live capture hooks installed.
within_cohort_graph: Before labels, union all shared task/parent/session/run/exact-input/near-duplicate edges. Cross-reservation connections become ONE group or quarantine the entire connected group. Never count related reservations as independent tasks.
labels_privacy: Separate two blinded complete-input policy reviews and explicit local privacy approval. Teacher output, classifier output and private reasoning are hidden. Disagreement, UNKNOWN, missing evidence, unsupported language or privacy hold stays quarantined. Same-model agreement is not human gold.
problem_slices: original requirements/unmet outcomes versus new repair advice
instruction to summary author versus instruction to future coder
quoted existing code/errors versus prescribed literal replacements/calls/commands
cosmetic/code-format variants and decisive evidence location
locking: Freeze complete eligible inputs, raw/quarantine accounting, ancestry graph, labels, slice tags, tokenizer fit, classifier/export hashes, score rule and metric code BEFORE first evaluation inference. No TRAIN/DEV/calibration/augmentation use, including the shared encoder. One preregistered evaluation; subsequent iteration requires another fresh cohort.
report: Per-head/class confusion, missed PLAN/DICTATES, false blocking, complete-input coverage, NO_FIT, unresolved labels and each requested problem slice; per-task/harness/language/length support. Uncertainty over independent task groups; no independent-row confidence fiction. Report missing slices explicitly.
exclusion_scope: Mechanical index covers all738qualified real candidate inputs/their known task/session/run associations and all72seed proposals/18seed groups, including withheld/inactive cases. It is NOT an exhaustive index of unjoined archive traffic, prior public controls, pretraining data or every exposure. Exact whole-task text fingerprints cover all checked-in task templates (including the six represented roots, with original/outer-whitespace forms) and the19legacy native roots; this does not certify more general semantic novelty.
prior_exposure_review: Before certifying a reservation, reviewers must inspect existing archive-audit metadata exposure references and disclosed historical replay/control banks, not just this exact-input index. Exposure inventory is nonexhaustive; unresolved earlier ancestry/exposure is a hold, never proof of freshness. No closed-walk index is recreated.
policy_change_rule: Any policy/meaning revision requires a new version and review of affected labels/reservations before inference, not silent recoding of held cases.
source_adapter_status: Dedicated native-string candidate/native-integer-nanosecond profile tested. Existing enveloped question/ISO-timestamp captures require a producer-specific complete-source adapter after the collection source is approved; this is NOT an installed native collector.
